purpose: Which venture each GitHub repository belongs to, and where a venture's clones live on Krish's PC. The dev sprawl report reads it; nothing moves because of it. A move still needs Krish's consent row for that exact folder in policy/folder-preferences.json.
venture_slugs: Control Center's venture slugs (get_venture_state), plus makeyourmindup, personal, mindmake_os and shared (serves several ventures, so it has no venture home).

makeyourmindup.source: Wave 2 W2.11 local layout: repos in dev\makeyourmindup\<repo>, worktrees in .worktrees\<repo>\<branch>

preserve.why: Growth's .scratch holds its local, git-ignored working state; a move keeps it byte for byte and nothing re-clones over it (Wave 3 W3.4).

notes.krishanraja/inspirationhouse: Krish, 2026-10-29: it "has a ledger for every venture, but in reality 99% of its work is for makeyourmindup right now though that may change". Shared, so it does not move into dev\makeyourmindup.
notes.krishanraja/sendlinks: Krish, 2026-10-29: "sendlinks is a part of control center but standalone machinery".

out_of_scope_note: Krish, 2026-10-29: "the rest are standalone/personal projects you dont need to be across". The sprawl report leaves their clones out entirely. Any other repository not listed shows as unplaced until Krish places it.
